title: The CIA showed Elizondo MRIs of UAP witnesses with caudate putamen differences
summary: Lou Elizondo tells of The CIA showed Elizondo MRIs of UAP witnesses with caudate putamen differences, about when Elizondo joined the program at The Pentagon, Arlington, Virginia, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: from my point of view when I got involved the CIA came to my office and then they showed me MRIs of some of these people and most of those people had interactions with UFOs

plain: Lue Elizondo is a former Pentagon official who says he worked in a programme that studied UFOs. He tells podcast host Jesse Michels that when he got involved, people from the CIA, the US foreign spy agency, came to his Pentagon office and showed him brain scans of people who had UFO encounters. He says most of those people showed differences in the caudate putamen, a region deep in the brain, which would suggest such encounters leave a physical mark.
